_doc: Diplomacy for gold (assist/diplomacy.py), player decisions 2026-10-21: join-war offers to major factions against minors and majors at most half the player's strength; always the most gold the AI accepts.
'off': faction keys the player turned off in the expanded widget, per kind of deal; every faction is on unless listed here.
'enabled': join-war deals on or off; 'major_target_max_strength': a major faction is a join-war target only at most this share of the player's strength (0.5 = half). Both set in the expanded widget.
